obligations.statement:
## U01 — Real Lean/kernel acceptance

Blocker: No installed compiler; official asset/network and artifact-size routes failed with retained diagnostics.

Method: Obtain exact 4.19.0 or document a deliberate migration; run verify.py, repair all actual elaboration errors without weakening statements and inspect all required declarations.
obligations.residual: The exact historical obligation remains preserved. Listed continuation components are narrower evidence, not closure of the whole item.

obligations.statement:
## U02 — Actual transitive assumption and statement fidelity audit

Blocker: The emitted in-Lean audit command is uncompiled; no actual footprint is known.

Method: Build all twelve modules, require every declared name/type, compile RequiredAudit with #ortho_audit, inspect the actual smaller footprint and review theorem statements against AC01–AC16.
obligations.residual: The exact historical obligation remains preserved. Listed continuation components are narrower evidence, not closure of the whole item.

obligations.statement:
## U03 — Whole deployed parser/checker/exporter refinement

Blocker: Python/JSON behaviour and eight examples are finitely checked, not universally verified.

Method: Extract the finite checker or prove raw decode/structural validation/substitution/check/serialize refinement, including budgets and rejection paths.
obligations.residual: The exact historical obligation remains preserved. Listed continuation components are narrower evidence, not closure of the whole item.

obligations.statement:
## U04 — Operational formal model to actual registry/lock implementation

Blocker: Typed Plan model abstracts resource refusal and does not contain the full mutable issuer registry or probability grammar.

Method: State a simulation over complete Gamma/issued-record/lock states and prove successful concrete transitions refine abstract checked transitions, including failure atomicity and concurrency linearisation.
obligations.residual: The exact historical obligation remains preserved. Listed continuation components are narrower evidence, not closure of the whole item.

obligations.statement:
## U05 — Actual measure-theoretic formalisation

Blocker: Q1–Q8 measure and computability arguments are ordinary proofs; preserved AlmostSureBoundary is only a logical abstraction.

Method: Pin Mathlib; define positive singleton support, countability, restrictions, pushforwards, all-event property, sums and weak limits; prove Q1–Q4/Q7 and formalise the Q8 reduction separately.
obligations.residual: The exact historical obligation remains preserved. Listed continuation components are narrower evidence, not closure of the whole item.

obligations.statement:
## U06 — Unbounded typed sampler and productive observer semantics

Blocker: Bounded source APIs and ideal ordinary stream arguments are not a mechanised probability space.

Method: Give a guarded/coinductive stream semantics, prefix cylinder law and stopping-time measure; prove total mass, certified leaves, exact tails/expectations and finite-cap relation to Python.
obligations.residual: The exact historical obligation remains preserved. Listed continuation components are narrower evidence, not closure of the whole item.

obligations.statement:
## U07 — Computational cost and entropy-law assurance

Blocker: Counters exclude parsing, allocation, validation, entropy acquisition and real CPU costs; fair input law is a premise.

Method: Choose an explicit instruction/bit-cost model and entropy assumption; prove implementation costs or measure separately, never infer time from expected bits.
obligations.residual: The exact historical obligation remains preserved. Listed continuation components are narrower evidence, not closure of the whole item.

obligations.statement:
## U08 — General fixed-point correspondence

Blocker: A concrete singleton correspondence is solved ordinarily; no general compactness/selection theorem has been formalised here.

Method: Use a pinned existing Kakutani development, define the actual safe domain and correspondence and discharge all hypotheses; separately prove effective realisation or exhibit its impossibility.
obligations.residual: General Kakutani hypotheses and effective realization are not discharged by a different finite fixed-point theorem.

obligations.statement:
## U09 — Finite-source normalisation and conversion-completeness bridges

Blocker: Preserved System F translation and compatible SKI confluence/completeness arguments remain unmechanised.

Method: Mechanise translation/substitution, nonempty reduction simulation and exact modulo-conversion counterexample; keep K t Omega semantic obstruction unchanged.
obligations.residual: The exact historical obligation remains preserved. Listed continuation components are narrower evidence, not closure of the whole item.

obligations.statement:
## U10 — Full logical relations / semantic parametricity

Blocker: New R1 only treats finite pure derivations; its source is uncompiled.

Method: Compile it, then specify and prove stronger relation-environment/identity-extension/effect/dependent rules only with the needed hypotheses; compare Pistone Theorems 5.21/7.1.
obligations.residual: The exact historical obligation remains preserved. Listed continuation components are narrower evidence, not closure of the whole item.

obligations.statement:
## U11 — Contextual dependent substitution, J and universe rules

Blocker: Existing Pi/Sigma/coherence semantics is not a full dependent calculus or decidable kernel.

Method: Specify contexts, substitutions, dependent eliminators and judgmental equalities, prove substitution/soundness and explain the exact universe closure excluded by SCUU.
obligations.residual: The exact historical obligation remains preserved. Listed continuation components are narrower evidence, not closure of the whole item.

obligations.statement:
## U12 — Exact-length trace and backend/contextual correctness

Blocker: Finite symbolic traces are tested and exportable but the full length-indexed simulation and contextual compiler refinement are absent.

Method: Introduce an indexed trace relation, prove each replay step and strategy cost; define effect/observable contexts and verify backend lowering before any performance claim.
obligations.residual: The exact historical obligation remains preserved. Listed continuation components are narrower evidence, not closure of the whole item.

obligations.statement:
## U13 — Novelty, priority and foundational importance

Blocker: Only a bounded source-grounded comparison exists; no independent specialist review occurred.

Method: Compare exact hypotheses/conclusions with closest complete primary work, obtain independent review, and distinguish elementary application/engineering from new mathematics.
obligations.residual: The exact historical obligation remains preserved. Listed continuation components are narrower evidence, not closure of the whole item.

obligations.statement:
## U14 — Real-world law binding and distributed authority

Blocker: The host declares law models and owns local mutable state; no external authenticated law oracle or distributed revocation is implemented.

Method: Specify independent evidence provenance and an external system model; verify authentication, freshness, discovery and multi-process consistency if that deployment is pursued.
obligations.residual: The exact historical obligation remains preserved. Listed continuation components are narrower evidence, not closure of the whole item.

obligations.statement: In a specified total primitive-recursive synchronous observer language, zero defect is Pi03-complete and positive defect Sigma03-complete; full rational threshold table and finite Mealy decidability.
obligations.residual: Exact observer/law, language/encoding and operational-version contracts remain necessary; no identification with the occurrence-centred core is inferred.

obligations.statement: For a persistent issued record under strict monotone versions and complete captured reads, a licence survives a revision sequence iff no captured dependency is touched; independent semantic defect transport and Girard boundary.
obligations.residual: Exact observer/law, language/encoding and operational-version contracts remain necessary; no identification with the occurrence-centred core is inferred.

obligations.statement: All seven Lean modules are authored but uncompiled here and in v3. Python success is not a kernel proof. The report is candid; this is an open obligation, not dishonesty.
obligations.residual: Compile all twelve modules, fix elaboration and run the mandatory transitive-assumption audit.

obligations.statement: The target string says v4.19.0, but the observed --version is only recorded. A controlled subprocess fixture reporting version 0.0.0 still produces the top-level success report.
obligations.residual: Actual identity and compilation remain unobserved; this is a repaired policy, not a build receipt.

obligations.statement: One unrelated axiom-readback line per module satisfies the readback flag. The controlled fixture creates no oleans yet is labelled kernel_verified. This tests orchestration assumptions, not Lean soundness.
obligations.residual: Compile the meta command, all targets and audit; inspect actual types and assumptions. No axiom footprint inferred from static source.

obligations.statement: Replacing named substitution by the constant bottom function is caught normally, but the same 335,744-case census reports PASS under -O because assertions disappear.
obligations.residual: Finite census is not a general substitution proof.

obligations.statement: The absent-manifest branch reports NOT_PRESENT_BEFORE_PACKAGING without setting failure. A development convenience must not be accepted as final archive custody.
obligations.residual: Custody is hash/coverage evidence, not semantic correctness.

obligations.statement: Unlike the reference-test loop, Lean version/compile calls do not catch timeout or OS exceptions. Some environment failures may terminate without a complete final status.
obligations.residual: Local trusted compiler/process/OS boundary remains; no hostile-code sandbox claim.

obligations.statement: The package has a dict checker, not a raw JSON-byte parser. Standard decoding overwrites duplicate rule fields and the remaining valid dict is accepted. The claim that duplicate rejection already exists is inaccurate; no typing unsoundness is shown.
obligations.residual: No formal proof of the Python parser has been supplied.

obligations.statement: A bounded accepted proof with nested all-introductions returns a type that the same structural validator rejects as too deep. Input and produced-output limits are not compositionally aligned.
obligations.residual: This establishes tested bounded behaviour, not OS-level memory isolation.

obligations.statement: None and dict inputs to replay_selector do not reach a declared Rejection. The typed Python API expects a SelectorCertificate, so this is a trust-boundary hardening issue, not acceptance of an invalid proof.
obligations.residual: Native caller objects are not authority; actual checked bytes remain the interface.

obligations.statement: Local depth/node limits do not establish aggregate proof-size, integer-bit, output-support, recursion, or memory bounds. The sampler API is capped and the probability interpreter has its own limits.
obligations.residual: No complete CPU/allocator/OS resource proof or security sandbox. Quantitative bit-cost is separately conditional.

obligations.statement: FiniteBridge supplies a proposed proof-carrying checker, while Python uses its own dict syntax, cutoff substitution and reduction traces. Finite agreement is useful but not an unbounded implementation theorem.
obligations.residual: Neither the exporter nor Python parser is universally verified; exported targets are uncompiled. Extract or prove the real parser/checker refinement.

obligations.statement: The semantic repertoire contains arbitrary stable predicates and families; finite syntax names a restricted fragment. A finite introduction rule can soundly quantify over the semantic universe without representing all its families.
obligations.residual: No finite enumeration or decision of all semantic codes is asserted. Kernel implementation remains under RV01.

obligations.statement: V3 has no implemented operational Context-revision/projected-dispatch calculus matching the frozen O/Γ/OWOU contract. The existing internal model is a valuable core, not automatically that engine.
obligations.residual: Kernel-check the model and prove the complete deployed Python refinement, including registry/resource semantics.

obligations.statement: Reach as a polymorphic signature plus soundness/fail-closed implications can be vacuous. Packaging them in OWOU does not demonstrate useful open-world capacity.
obligations.residual: Finite execution and ordinary specification proof do not certify the whole implementation.

obligations.statement: Earlier discussion occasionally said quantification alone yields parametricity. With the allowed classical Lean axioms that claim is false for arbitrary ambient functions.
obligations.residual: No full semantic-realiser parametricity or JSON representation of arbitrary ambient types.

obligations.statement: The two threads have distinct positive requirements. The frozen relational design must be reconciled with, not substituted for, internal All(B).
obligations.residual: Mathematical construction is ordinary; original formalisation still awaits kernel checking.

obligations.statement: The licensed adaptation targets a specific self-product package. It must be compiled and connected to the actual SCUUAt interface; a generic slogan is not that bridge.
obligations.residual: Compile the extraction and audit universe levels and transitive assumptions. No current Mathlib installation is claimed.

obligations.statement: A bundled closure-plus-realisation structure and the corresponding existential are equivalent packaging. Earlier assurance that the field alone solved vacuity was overstated.
obligations.residual: The authored correspondence is uncompiled and not an all-operations embedding.

obligations.statement: Keeping K fixed does not show an old certificate remains admissible after Γ changes. Revoked authority, changed observations or changed code invalidate old claims.
obligations.residual: Kernel-level refinement and distributed revocation are not proved. The host process is trusted.

obligations.statement: Type-correct or logically admissible code can still consume resources or act beyond authority. Current selector proofs do not establish full host memory/capability security.
obligations.residual: No empirical law identification, physical safety, moral warrant or remote authentication claim.

obligations.statement: The ordinary proof is sound under measurable singletons and the stated event family. Positive point mass is not synonymous with arbitrary measurable atoms on every space.
obligations.residual: Ordinary probability proof only; actual measure-theoretic Lean targets remain open.

obligations.statement: V3 already notes its countable carrier. All laws on that discrete carrier satisfy point-concentration; the continuum result binds only a justified enlarged observation/outcome space.
obligations.residual: Do not infer rich-event necessity from merely finite source predicates.

obligations.statement: Coarse atomic observations can refine to diffuse ones, invalidating an earlier universal almost-sure claim while K stays fixed.
obligations.residual: No generic estimator or executable decision for arbitrary laws; full deployed refinement remains open.

obligations.statement: The supplied Lean module abstracts laws of a Full predicate. It does not construct Lebesgue measure, positive-point countability, pushforwards or weak convergence.
obligations.residual: Use pinned Mathlib measures to prove point countability, pushforward/restriction sums, event measurability, Q1/Q2/Q4/Q7 and the continuum examples.

obligations.statement: Weights constrain syntax, while the Lean Outcome relation tracks possible outcomes. It does not prove the actual rational distribution or independent sampling law of the Python interpreter.
obligations.residual: No formal quantitative law for the implementation or a general effectful fundamental theorem.

obligations.statement: The prefix routine consumes supplied finite bits and returns a selector tag or undecided result, with a cap. The infinite fair-bit operational object and typed program output are not integrated into the finite source checker.
obligations.residual: Construct and kernel-check the unbounded productive source semantics and its measure. The Python API deliberately caps at 128 bits.

obligations.statement: The tail and expected-bit calculation are convincing ordinary arguments. Arbitrary-precision integer work requires its own cost model.
obligations.residual: No instruction-level CPU or allocator benchmark/proof.

obligations.statement: A finite probability simplex is safe for point concentration, but a useful fixed-point application needs at least one certified program and the exact nonempty convex values/graph conditions.
obligations.residual: General Kakutani formalisation/selection and full native measure semantics remain open; no arbitrary real-law realisability.

obligations.statement: V3 correctly separates existence and contraction. Its one-dimensional constructive example does not establish computability or convergence of arbitrary Kakutani selections.
obligations.residual: Ordinary proof; no general equilibrium convergence claim.

obligations.statement: The finite-source System F transfer and modulo-conversion incompleteness use ordinary reasoning and external normalization. The supplied Lean module proves different portions, not the full transfer.
obligations.residual: Mechanise the actual translation, substitution and nonempty reduction simulation against an existing checked System F development.

obligations.statement: K t Ω shows that every inhabited conversion-invariant code contains a non-strongly-normalising term under full compatible reduction. A chosen weak-head evaluation may nevertheless terminate.
obligations.residual: Full formal conversion-completeness bridge remains RV30; weak-head behaviour is not inferred from this counterexample.

obligations.statement: Identity, global selector and numeral theorems are useful, with marker-freshness and orbit hypotheses. They do not give a fundamental theorem for arbitrary relation environments and effects.
obligations.residual: Compile this fragment. It does not imply all unary semantic realisers are Reynolds-parametric or cover effects/dependent contexts.

obligations.statement: The Python certificate checks a chosen head-step trace with a length. The Lean reduction transport result uses unindexed Red; it does not by itself certify that exact k or the same evaluation strategy.
